about.subtitle: A little about me
about.lead: I am a psychologist and integrative psychotherapist in training. I love nature, cats, and honest conversations that bring clarity and meaning.
about.intro: I believe everyone has inner resources for healing. Sometimes, though, we need a guide and a warm presence to help us through moments of confusion.
about.value1d: Confidentiality, unconditional acceptance, and genuine empathy.
about.value2d: Flexible techniques tailored to your emotional needs and pace.
about.value3d: We build a relationship based on trust, safety, and mutual respect.
story: I am 33 and I like my age. I have two adopted cats and love them dearly.

Psychology was a second chance I gave myself, and it helped me find myself again. I enjoy growing personally and professionally. I am proud of how far I have come, though I still have difficult days. That makes me human, and I try not to treat others in ways I would not want to be treated.

In our sessions, I bring knowledge that I continually update from scientifically sound sources, and I am ready to meet you with all your feelings and thoughts. I have gathered the theory and practical methods that may help.

I am honest, direct when needed, and careful with the person in front of me. I will not promise a miraculous recovery in a set time. I will help you understand yourself and work toward feeling better by the end of our work together.
I will also encourage you to work on yourself between our sessions.
about.testimonial: “I felt heard, guided, supported, validated, and understood. For the first time, someone was not judging me, but seeing me exactly as I am.”
about.choose: Choose what feels right for you
offerings: Individual sessions online or in person in Iași

about.nextText: If you feel ready to stop carrying everything alone, I am here.

journal.subtitle: A guide to transformation & introspection
journal.title: The Expat Woman’s Journal
journal.tagline: Thoughts and feelings of a woman blossoming far from her roots
journal.quote1: “The author has created a tool that truly adds value to my life. Filling in this guide feels like a ritual – a hygge moment carved out of the daily rush, where I can take care of myself and process my emotions as an expat. On top of all that, it comes with an amazing group of women from all over the world – a community I can connect with just one click away. The best gift you can give yourself 💯”
why: I left Romania full of excitement, because I was tired of crying and of living with anger and guilt. I left because I could no longer stay.
If you, too, are a woman living far from the country that shaped you, but where you no longer felt you belonged, then you know what I am talking about.
The Expat Woman’s Journal is not a classic journal. No little hearts, no motivational affirmations. It is a therapeutic space. Clear, honest, sometimes uncomfortable, but deeply liberating.
A place where you can finally sit with yourself, without apologising for feeling too much or for not being enough.

It contains questions that dig into deep layers, and exercises designed by a woman psychologist who left, tore herself away from her roots, cried from longing and hardship, and learned to put herself back together.
journal.whyPromise: It does not promise healing. It promises that you will no longer feel like you are the only one.
features: 52 therapeutic themes dedicated to expat women
Questions about emotions, relationships, needs, longing and identity
Moments of introspection and presence with yourself
Space for gratitude, reflection and plans for your well-being
journal.audience: It is for you if you are blossoming far from your roots. An honest gift for any Romanian expat woman, or for yourself.
journal.quote2: “The author of this journal asks important questions about one’s new life, identity and self-perception. The journal deepens and supports a good analysis of one’s current situation. It is an excellent tool for finding yourself again or for connecting with your (new?) self. I warmly recommend it if you need a guide to bring order to your thoughts, feelings and life.”
journal.refugeTitle: A place of refuge and inner order
refuge: If you are an expat woman too, you already know that beyond beautiful landscapes and new cultures come longing, fears, unanswered questions, emotions that are hard to carry and needs you keep putting off. This journal is your place of refuge. The space where you can bring order to your thoughts, emotions and wishes, without a mask.

It is not just a journal for writing down what you did today. It is a 52-week guide that invites you to sit with yourself, take a break from the to-do list of life far from your roots, and ask your soul how it feels. Through weekly themes, meaningful questions and moments of introspection, the journal helps you understand your emotions, recognise which relationships nourish you and which drain you, and discover what “home” means to you, beyond coordinates on a map.
journal.psyQuote: “Reading Anca’s journal, I realised how much I would have wished for a tool like this to document my experience as an expat woman more than 10 years ago. Many of my feelings from back then have been lost, and when I try to remember them, I realise that my perception has changed in the meantime... Through this journal, Anca manages to map an extremely deep journey, tracing the borders of a new identity and drawing emotional landscapes of boundless beauty. At the end of this journey you will find yourself – much stronger, wiser and more aware – and may everything you have recorded in this journal become the most beautiful success story: YOURS!”
